messages:
Raj (Support): FYI — incoming customer asks for a single streaming API that can do chat streaming + function/tool calling mid-stream + structured JSON frames for downstream ingestion. Ticket: https://support.example/t/3245 :eyes:
Anne (Sales): they said low latency and want tool results delivered as soon as available, not batched at the end. Big logos, potential ARR if we can ship. :star:
Maria (PM): can you paste the exact customer ask and acceptance criteria from the ticket? we need concrete launch must-haves before we scope. :thinking:
Raj (Support): pasted excerpt below. also asked for example consumer flow: user prompts -> model streams tokens -> when model triggers, a tool is called and tool output streams back into the same connection, then final structured JSON summary is emitted. They want schema validation on the final JSON and ability to backfill missing fields from tool outputs.
Anne (Sales): customer will pay for a premium SLA if this supports partial tool outputs. they need it in prod in ~3 months, but can accept phased delivery.
Maria (PM): ok — two axes: correctness (schema + tool fidelity) and latency (tool output mid-stream). propose scope options: A) streaming tokens + final fncall at end (fast, low risk); B) streaming tokens + 'tool stubs' mid-stream with later function execution (medium); C) true mid-stream tool invocation + tool output frames + structured frames (high). we need engineering estimates and a security review for C.
Evan (Eng): technical constraints: our current streaming path assumes model emits until it decides to call a function, then we buffer until function result attaches. supporting mid-stream tool output means we need: 1) event envelope changes (token / tool_event / structured_frame), 2) runtime changes for interruptible tool invocation, 3) safe merge of tool output into KV cache without breaking attention. dev estimate: B = ~2 sprints, C = 3-4 sprints + infra changes.
Sasha (ML Eng): ML concerns: model will sometimes interleave hallucinated tool outputs. we need strict schema enforcement and an eval harness that catches regressions. for streaming structured frames, prefer emitting validated frames with a signature: {"type":"structured","schema":"v1","payload":"...","sig":"..."} so downstream can trust it. also need prompt templates + eval set.
Raj (Support): customer provided sample prompt and expected structured schema. attaching snippet in ticket. they also noted fallback behavior: when tool service is down, they want partial tokens + a clear 'tool_unavailable' structured event.
Maria (PM): acceptance criteria (draft): 1) API supports token + tool_event + structured_frame envelope; 2) tool outputs can be emitted mid-stream and consumed by client; 3) schema validation and opt-in signature on structured frames; 4) graceful fallback to non-streaming mode + clear error event. Which scopes are must-have vs nice-to-have?
Anne (Sales): Must-have: mid-stream tool outputs or at minimum tool stubs that unblock their UX. Schema signature is nice-to-have but they care more about reliability and latency.
Evan (Eng): note on infra: we'll need additional tracing hooks and per-request state to sequence tool events; also quota/accounting changes. also changes to our SDKs to expose the event types.
Sasha (ML Eng): recommend we run a small pilot with one customer and one tool (search) to validate flow and tune prompt behavior before general rollout. that will reduce ML risk.
Maria (PM): next steps: Evan — get a rough engineering estimate for A/B/C by EOD Friday. Sasha — propose validation/signature scheme and eval checklist. Raj — attach ticket logs and customer example prompts. Anne — confirm commercial priority and SLA ask. i'll add this to the product backlog as a triage item with the 3 scope options.
Evan (Eng): quick protocol sketch for the team to review:
```
data: {"type":"token","text":"Calculating..."}
data: {"type":"tool_call_start","tool":"search","args":{...}}
data: {"type":"tool_output","tool":"search","chunk":"Results snippet..."}
data: {"type":"tool_call_end"}
data: {"type":"structured","schema":"order_v1","payload":"{\"order_id\":123}","sig":"<base64>"}
```
Anne (Sales): perfect, that helps the customer team visualize. they preferred line-delimited JSON streaming.
Raj (Support): adding :thumbsup: from customer contact in ticket. support-bot: created backlog item PLAT-9876 and linked ticket.
Maria (PM): great — i'll run this at monday prioritization and propose a phased roadmap entry. thanks everyone.
Evan (Eng): +1, will post estimates here when ready.
Sasha (ML Eng): will draft evals and a quick pilot plan.
Anne (Sales): will push for pilot approval on customer side. :rocket:
